description: Per-technique prevalence estimates: p is the estimated share of evasive samples on the technique's platforms that perform the check. Point estimates combine the catalog tier prior with the share of sourced families in catalog/threats.json; intervals are deliberately wide and are widest where fewer than three families are sourced. See docs/THREATS.md (Method).

basis.finding: Tier 'very_common' prior p=0.3.
3 of 107 sourced families on linux, macos, windows have a cited check for this technique.
Evasive techniques detected in 67.8% of Windows samples from 2010, rising to about 80% by 2019; 46 families are characterised by their choice of techniques.
Over 40% of 6,900 Windows samples reduced malicious behaviour under a VM or with a debugger attached; VM alone changed behaviour for 2.7% (167 of 6,222).
